objective: Escort Kernobee to the Clockwerk Run exit and then report to Scooty in Booty Bay.

description: The last thing I remember is being captured by a group of dark iron dwarves, beaten to within an inch of my life and then thrown in here with these filthy troggs.

Here's the plan: Lead me to the exit; if we make it out alive, you go to Booty Bay and let Scooty know that I went to Ratchet to warn Tinkerwiz of the dark iron's involvement in the making of that super rig.
completion: I suppose you should be rewarded for bringing Kernobee back to us in one piece, <name>. If you go back to Gnomeregan, these might give you the edge you'll need in defeating that good-for-nothing backstabber, Mekgineer Thermaplugg.
